[[Damask Holdings/Legends|Damask Holdings]] maintained an '''accounting facility''' on the [[Volcano/Legends|volcanic]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Mustafar/Legends|Mustafar]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. It was used by [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==History==
The facility was originally a reclamation station owned by [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] [[Vigo/Legends|Boss]] [[Cabra]]. The [[Dug/Legends|Dug]] crime lord used it for the discreet disposal of enemies and evidence, a purpose for which Mustafar had long ago proven useful. It was eventually made available to [[Darth Plagueis/Legends|Hego Damask]] and others, until it became an accounting facility for [[Damask Holdings/Legends|Damask Holdings]]. Damask kept custodial droids in the facility by [[54 BBY/Legends|54 BBY]].<ref name="Darth Plagueis" />

The young [[Darth Maul/Legends|Darth Maul]] was raised and trained in the facility. The Dathomirian was taken care of by the custodian droids and personally tutored by [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]] himself in the ways of the dark side. The young [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] also trained with his caretaker droid and was given a small room with only one small window that gave only a small view of the planet. It was then temporarily abandoned when Sidious and Maul departed for the [[Orsis Academy]] on [[Orsis]]. Maul would later return to train in the facility after he [[Massacre at Orsis Academy|murdered everyone]] in the Academy.<ref name="The Wrath of Darth Maul" /> He would use it again shortly after his [[Mission to Ralltiir|dismantling]] of [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]].<ref name="Darth Plagueis" /><ref name="Shadow Hunter">''[[Darth Maul: Shadow Hunter]]''</ref>

Sidious used this facility as a base of operations during his plan to kidnap [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Youngling/Legends|younglings]] with the assistance<ref name="guide">{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/guide/episode203.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: Children of the Force}}</ref> of the [[Duros/Legends|Duros]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]]<ref name="DB-Bane, Cad">{{DB|character|cadbane|Bane, Cad}}</ref> [[Cad Bane/Legends|Cad Bane]].<ref name="guide" /> In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="Children of the force date" /> both the plot and the facility were discovered by [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]]<ref name="ani-db">{{DB|character|anakinskywalker|Skywalker, Anakin}}</ref> [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]]<ref name="guide" /> and his [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]],<ref name="ani-db" /> [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]].<ref name="guide" /> In an attempt to keep his involvement secret, Sidious ordered that the station's [[Gravity/Legends|gravity]] supports be deactivated, allowing it to sink into the [[Magma/Legends|lava]] below. The two [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Mission to Mustafar (Skywalker and Tano)/Legends|infiltrated]] the base, rescued the kidnapped younglings, and fled as it sank into one of Mustafar's lava flows.<ref name="guide" />
